# Libraries
```{r libraries, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(ggpubr)
library(here)
library(reshape2)
library(viridis)
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 15))

```

# functions
```{r se function}
#make function for standard error
 se <- function(x, na.rm = FALSE) {
      if (na.rm) x <- na.omit(x)
      sd(x) / sqrt(length(x))
 }
```

## load dfs
```{r load dfs, echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
tilecover <- read_csv(here::here("Data", "Tile Data  - Vertical_Data_Sheet.csv")) %>%
  mutate(site = as.factor(site), 
         tile_ID = as.factor(tile_ID)) %>%
  mutate_if(is.numeric , replace_na, replace = 0)
```
## clean dfs
```{r clean dfs}
#sum by phyla
phyladf <- tilecover %>%
 mutate(Porifera_cover = as.numeric(rowSums(select(., matches("porifera|sponge"))))) %>%
 mutate(PAC_cover = as.numeric(rowSums(select(., matches("PAC"))))) %>%
 mutate(CCA_cover = as.numeric(rowSums(select(., matches("CCA"))))) %>%
  mutate(Macroalgae_cover = as.numeric(rowSums(select(., matches("algae"))))) %>%
  mutate(Bryozoan_cover = as.numeric(rowSums(select(., matches("bryozoan"))))) %>%
  mutate(Turf_cover = as.numeric(rowSums(select(., matches("turf"))))) %>%
 mutate(Chordata_cover = as.numeric(rowSums(select(., matches("chordata|tunicate|eudistoma|phallusia|lissoclinum"))))) %>%
 mutate(Mollusca_cover = as.numeric(rowSums(select(., matches("mollusk|bivalve|chiton|mollusca"))))) %>%
  mutate(Macroalgae_cover = as.numeric(rowSums(select(., matches("algae"))))) %>%
  mutate(Cnidaria_cover = as.numeric(rowSums(select(., matches("zooanths|anemone|zooanthid"))))) %>%
  mutate(Echinodermata_cover = as.numeric(rowSums(select(., matches("star"))))) %>%
 mutate(Annelida_cover = as.numeric(rowSums(select(., matches("duster|tube|worm")))))

#remove columns that were combined
## if you add columns as you increase the sites, make sure to increase the "57" to whatever the number of variables is on "tilecover"
## AND make sure all of the new column names, have something accounted for in the sum by phyla chunk
phyladf <- subset(phyladf, select = -c(3:57))
```

then we want to take the percent cover data, and make a vertical file that has a column for each cover "type" with the percent for each tile 
```{r percent cover vertical}
#get just percent cover so i can make a bar plot
percentvert <- melt(phyladf, id = c("site", "tile_ID"), variable.name = "cover") %>% 
  rename(percent = value)

# get site level averages so we can have standard error
percentvert_averages <- percentvert %>%
  group_by(site, cover) %>%
  summarise(mean_cover = mean(percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_cover = se(percent, na.rm = TRUE))
```


# Visualization
```{r}
# no average standard error
coverbar <- ggplot(data = percentvert, mapping = aes(fill = cover, y = percent, x = factor(site))) +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", stat = "identity") +
  labs(title="Taxa coverage on tiles", x="", y="percent cover", fill = "") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
        legend.position = c(0.90,0.70), # change these values to move the plot legend aorund 
        legend.text = element_text(face = "italic"))

coverbar


# averages and standard error
coveravg <- ggplot(data = percentvert_averages, mapping = aes(fill = cover, y = mean_cover, x = factor(site))) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE) +
  geom_errorbar(data = percentvert_averages, aes(x = site, ymin = mean_cover - se_cover, ymax = mean_cover + se_cover), width = 0.1, color = "darkslategrey", stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  labs(title="Average taxa cover on tiles", x="", y="average percent cover", fill = "") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
        legend.position = c(0.96,0.9),
        legend.text = element_text(face = "italic"))

coveravg

```
